sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 760. Success value 100. 3x magic damage (Fire).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 130. Prohibits Unison for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Slumber for 40 seconds with a success value of 100.
-Target: all enemies. Removes 40 Cost.
-Target: all allies. Applies Rage for 90 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
-Target: yourself. Applies Rampart for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases all elemental Unison damage Ability Power by 200; [Special] increases success value of all status ailment attacks, including Unison Effects and Ability Effects, by 50; nullifies special debuffs; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 20000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Permits piercing through damage reduction/reflection effects when attacking for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 20000
Fire and Light Defense from Unison Damage +500
